                    text: [32m'Title: \n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'URL Source: https://getalchemystai.com/docs/integrations/sdk/typescript-sdk.md\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'Markdown Content:\n'[39m +
                      [32m'> ## Documentation Index\n'[39m +
                      [32m'> Fetch the complete documentation index at: https://getalchemystai.com/docs/llms.txt\n'[39m +
                      [32m'> Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'# Typescript SDK\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'> Get started with the Alchemyst Typescript SDK\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'### Installation\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m' ```bash Npm theme={null} npm install @alchemystai/sdk ``` ```bash Yarn theme={null} yarn add @alchemystai/sdk ``` ```bash Pnpm theme={null} pnpm add @alchemystai/sdk ``` ```bash Bun theme={null} bun add @alchemystai/sdk ``` \n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'### Authentication\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'Set your API key via environment variable or pass it directly when initializing the client.\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'* Recommended env var: `ALCHEMYST_AI_API_KEY`\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'```bash theme={null}\n'[39m +
                      [32m'export ALCHEMYST_AI_API_KEY="your_api_key_here"\n'[39m +
                      [32m'```\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'### Quickstart\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'```ts theme={null}\n'[39m +
                      [32m"import AlchemystAI from '@alchemystai/sdk';\n"[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'const client = new AlchemystAI({\n'[39m +
                      [32m'    apiKey: process.env.ALCHEMYST_AI_API_KEY,\n'[39m +
                      [32m'});\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'async function main() {\n'[39m +
                      [32m'  const res = await client.v1.context.view.retrieve();\n'[39m +
                      [32m'  console.log(res);\n'[39m +
                      [32m'}\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'main().catch(console.error);\n'[39m +
                      [32m'```\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'### Usage by Endpoint\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'All methods return a promise you can `await`. Types are available out-of-the-box in TypeScript.\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'#### Context: Add\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'```ts theme={null}\n'[39m +
                      [32m"import AlchemystAI from '@alchemystai/sdk';\n"[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'const client = new AlchemystAI({\n'[39m +
                      [32m'    apiKey: process.env.ALCHEMYST_AI_API_KEY,\n'[39m +
                      [32m'});\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'try {\n'[39m +
                      [32m'    await client.v1.context.add({\n'[39m +
                      [32m'       // [REQUIRED] The actual data to embed\n'[39m +
                      [32m'      documents: [\n'[39m +
                      [32m'                {\n'[39m +
                      [32m"                  content: 'The content of the document',\n"[39m +
                      [32m'                },\n'[39m +
                      [32m'              ],\n'[39m +
                      [32m'              // [REQUIRED] System classifications\n'[39m +
                      [32m"              context_type: 'resource',\n"[39m +
                      [32m"              source: 'web-upload',\n"[39m +
                      [32m"              scope: 'internal',\n"[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'              // [OPTIONAL] Can be null. Use for filtering later.\n'[39m +
                      [32m'              metadata: {\n'[39m +
                      [32m"                fileName: 'notes.txt',\n"[39m +
                      [32m"                fileType: 'text/plain',\n"[39m +
                      [32m'                lastModified: new Date().toISOString(),\n'[39m +
                      [32m'                fileSize: 1024,\n'[39m +
                      [32m"                groupName: ['group1', 'group2'],\n"[39m +
                      [32m'            },\n'[39m +
                      [32m'    });\n'[39m +
                      [32m'    console.log("Context successfully added.")\n'[39m +
                      [32m'    \n'[39m +
                      [32m'} catch (error) {\n'[39m +
                      [32m"    //Handles validation error (eg. missing required fields like 'documents')\n"[39m +
                      [32m'    console.error("Error adding context:", error)    \n'[39m +
                      [32m'}\n'[39m +
                      [32m'```\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m' **Version Requirements**: The `groupName` field is introduced in TypeScript SDK version 0.6.0. If you use `groupName` in previous versions, you will encounter an error. If `groupName` is not provided, it will be set to a default value REDACTEDmatically. \n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m" **groupName**: The group name acts like a namespace which creates a scope for context. Documents with the same group name will be grouped together for better organization and retrieval. **Example Use Cases**: * `['project-alpha']` - Group all documents related to a specific project * `['customer-support', 'tier-1']` - Organize support documentation by department and priority * `['legal', 'contracts']` - Categorize legal documents by type and category * `['training', 'onboarding']` - Group training materials for new employee onboarding \n"[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'#### Context: Search\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'```ts theme={null}\n'[39m +
                      [32m"import AlchemystAI from '@alchemystai/sdk';\n"[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'const client = new AlchemystAI({\n'[39m +
                      [32m'  apiKey: process.env.ALCHEMYST_AI_API_KEY,\n'[39m +
                      [32m'});\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'try {\n'[39m +
                      [32m'  const { contexts } = await client.v1.context.search({\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'    // [REQUIRED] Core search parameters\n'[39m +
                      [32m"    query: 'Your search query here',\n"[39m +
                      [32m'    similarity_threshold: 0.8,\n'[39m +
                      [32m'    minimum_similarity_threshold: 0.5,\n'[39m +
                      [32m"    scope: 'internal',\n"[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'    // Optional - can be null\n'[39m +
                      [32m'    body_metadata: {\n'[39m +
                      [32m"       groupName: ['project-alpha'],\n"[39m +
                      [32m"       fileType: 'ai/conversation',\n"[39m +
                      [32m'    },\n'[39m +
                      [32m'  });\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'  console.log(contexts);\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'} \n'[39m +
                      [32m'catch (error) {\n'[39m +
                      [32m'  console.error("Search failed:", error);\n'[39m +
                      [32m'}\n'[39m +
                      [32m'```\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'#### Context: Delete\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'```ts theme={null}\n'[39m +
                      [32m"import AlchemystAI from '@alchemystai/sdk';\n"[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'const client = new AlchemystAI({\n'[39m +
                      [32m'  apiKey: process.env.ALCHEMYST_AI_API_KEY,\n'[39m +
                      [32m'});\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'try {\n'[39m +
                      [32m'  await client.v1.context.delete({\n'[39m +
                      [32m'    // [REQUIRED] Must specify the source to delete from\n'[39m +
                      [32m"    source: 'web-upload',\n"[39m +
                      [32m'    \n'[39m +
                      [32m'    // [OPTIONAL] Target specific users or organizations\n'[39m +
                      [32m"    user_id: 'your_user_id', \n"[39m +
                      [32m"    organization_id: 'your_organization_id',\n"[39m +
                      [32m'    \n'[39m +
                      [32m'    // [REQUIRED] Flags to specify deletion scope (must set one)\n'[39m +
                      [32m'    by_doc: true,\n'[39m +
                      [32m'    by_id: false,\n'[39m +
                      [32m'  });\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'  console.log("Context deleted successfully.");\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'} catch (error) {\n'[39m +
                      [32m'  console.error("Failed to delete context:", error);\n'[39m +
                      [32m'}\n'[39m +
                      [32m'```\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'#### Context: View (per-user)\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'```ts theme={null}\n'[39m +
                      [32m"import AlchemystAI from '@alchemystai/sdk';\n"[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'const client = new AlchemystAI({\n'[39m +
                      [32m'    apiKey: process.env.ALCHEMYST_AI_API_KEY,\n'[39m +
                      [32m'});\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'try {\n'[39m +
                      [32m'    // Retrieves context specific to the authenticated user\n'[39m +
                      [32m'    const docs = await client.v1.context.view.docs();\n'[39m +
                      [32m'    console.log("User docs retrieved:", docs)\n'[39m +
                      [32m'} catch (error) {\n'[39m +
                      [32m'    console.error("Could not retrieve user docs:", error)\n'[39m +
                      [32m'}\n'[39m +
                      [32m'```\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m' **Per-user View**: This endpoint gives the authenticated user their own context from the organization. \n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'#### Context: Traces\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'```ts theme={null}\n'[39m +
                      [32m"import AlchemystAI from '@alchemystai/sdk';\n"[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'const client = new AlchemystAI({\n'[39m +
                      [32m'  apiKey: process.env.ALCHEMYST_AI_API_KEY,\n'[39m +
                      [32m'});\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'try {\n'[39m +
                      [32m'  // List all traces\n'[39m +
                      [32m'  const { traces } = await client.v1.context.traces.list();\n'[39m +
                      [32m'  console.log("Traces found:", traces);\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'  // Example: Delete a specific trace\n'[39m +
                      [32m'  if (traces.length > 0) {\n'[39m +
                      [32m'     const traceId = traces[0].id;\n'[39m +
                      [32m'     await client.v1.context.traces.delete(traceId);\n'[39m +
                      [32m'     console.log(`Trace ${traceId} deleted.`);\n'[39m +

                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'### Common errors (Add)\n'[39m +

                      [32m'| Status Code | Error Type        | Common Cause                                                                      | Recommended Fix                                                                                                                                       |\n'[39m +
                      [32m'| :---------- | :---------------- | :-------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | :---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |\n'[39m +
                      [32m'| **400**     | `BadRequest`      | Invalid JSON or missing required fields (e.g., `source`).                         | Validate your payload against the [schema](/api-reference/endpoint/api/v1/context/add/post). Ensure `documents` array is not empty.                   |\n'[39m +
                      [32m"| **401**     | `Unauthorized`    | Invalid or missing `ALCHEMYST_AI_API_KEY`.                                        | Check your `.env` file.                       [32m"| **403**     | `Forbidden`       | Accessing a `scope` (e.g., `user_123`) you don't have permission for.             | Verify the `api_key` or `user_id` matches the authenticated session.                       [32m'| **409**     | `Conflict`        | Document with the same `fileName` already exists.                                 | Follow [Pattern 2: Document Updates](/advanced/usage-patterns#pattern-2%3A-handling-document-updates) to update or replace existing documents safely. |\n'[39m +

                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'**Diagnosis:**\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'```javascript theme={null}\n'[39m +
                      [32m'// Sequential adds: ~30 seconds for 1000 docs\n'[39m +
                      [32m'for (let i = 0; i < 1000; i++) {\n'[39m +
                      [32m'  await alchemyst.add(documents[i]);\n'[39m +
                      [32m'}\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'// Async add: ~3 seconds for 1000 docs (10x faster!)\n'[39m +
                      [32m'// documents is an array of content\n'[39m +
                      [32m'const documents = [];\n'[39m +
                      [32m'documents.push({\n'[39m +
                      [32m'  content: "files content",\n'[39m +
                      [32m'  metadata: { // optional\n'[39m +
                      [32m'    file_name: "file_name",\n'[39m +
                      [32m'    file_type: "pdf/txt/json",\n'[39m +
                      [32m'    group_name: ["group1", "group2"],\n'[39m +
                      [32m'  },\n'[39m +
                      [32m'});\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'await alchemyst.add(documents);\n'[39m +
                      [32m'```\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'**Common Causes:**\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'* Document size > 50MB (max file size - 50MB)\n'[39m +
                      [32m'* Large number of documents uploaded sequentially\n'[39m +
                      [32m'* Token limit reached\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'**Solutions :**\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'1. Make sure the doc size is less then 50MB\n'[39m +
                      [32m'2. Upload documents via bulkAdd (faster)\n'[39m +
                      [32m'3. Check if you have sufficent tokens\n'[39m +
                      [32m'4. For bulk operations read [here](/advanced/usage-patterns#pattern-4%3A-bulk-operations-at-scale)\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'***\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'#### Slow Searches (> 1 second)\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'**Quick Checks:**\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'```javascript theme={null}\n'[39m +
                      [32m'// Measure your query time\n'[39m +
                      [32m'const start = Date.now();\n'[39m +
                      [32m'const result = await alchemyst.v1.context.search({\n'[39m +
                      [32m'  groupName: ["a", "b", "c", "d", "e", "f", "g"] // 7 filters!\n'[39m +
                      [32m'});\n'[39m +
                      [32m'console.log(`Search took ${Date.now() - start}ms`);\n'[39m +
                      [32m'```\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'**Common Causes:**\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'* 7+ groupName tags (exponential overhead)\n'[39m +
                      [32m'* No minimum\\_similarity\\_threshold set\n'[39m +
                      [32m'* 10K+ documents in scope\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'**Solutions:**\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'1. Reduce to 3-5 groupName tags max\n'[39m +
                      [32m'2. Set minimum\\_similarity\\_threshold: 0.5\n'[39m +
                      [32m'3. Use namespaces to shard data\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'***\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'### Retrieval Quality Issues\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'#### No Results Returned\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'**Quick Checks:**\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'```javascript theme={null}\n'[39m +
                      [32m'// 1. Verify documents exist\n'[39m +
                      [32m'const docs = await alchemyst.v1.context.view();\n'[39m +
                      [32m'console.log(`Total docs: ${docs.length}`);\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'// 2. Try broader search\n'[39m +
                      [32m'const result = await alchemyst.v1.context.search({\n'[39m +
                      [32m'  query: "your query",\n'[39m +
                      [32m'  similarity_threshold: 0.5, // Lower threshold\n'[39m +
                      [32m'  groupName: ["broad_tag"] // Fewer filters\n'[39m +
                      [32m'});\n'[39m +
                      [32m'```\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'**Common Causes:**\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'* High minimum\\_similarity\\_threshold set\n'[39m +
                      [32m"* groupnames don't intersect\n"[39m +
                      [32m'* Query is not relevant or very specific\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'**Solutions :**\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'1. Verify documents exist : [platform](https://platform.getalchemystai.com/context)\n'[39m +
                      [32m'2. Reduce similarity\\_threshold from 0.6-0.7 to 0.5-0.6\n'[39m +
                      [32m'3. Remove overly specific groupNames\n'[39m +
                      [32m"4. Try with a general query, make sure it's not too specific\n"[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'***\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'### Common Scenarios\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'#### Scenario: Queries Return Too Many Fragments\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'* **Problem:** Search returns 50+ small chunks\n'[39m +
                      [32m'* **Cause:** Over-segmentation (see [Anti-Pattern 1](/advanced/usage-patterns#anti-pattern-1%3A-over-segmentation))\n'[39m +
                      [32m'* **Solution:** Combine related content into cohesive documents\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'#### Scenario : Metadata Bloat Symptoms\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'* **Problem:** Storing too much or redundant information in metadata\n'[39m +
                      [32m'* **Cause:** Metadata bloating (see [Anti-Pattern 2](/advanced/usage-patterns#anti-pattern-2%3A-metadata-bloat))\n'[39m +
                      [32m'* **Solution:** Limit metadata to only what you query/filter by, pass all the other things in the content itself.\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'## Debugging Tools\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'* Context traces [API](/api-reference/endpoint/api/v1/context/traces/get) or [Platform](https://platform.getalchemystai.com/traces)\n'[39m +
                      [32m'* Verbose SDK [logging](/integrations/sdk/python-sdk#logging)\n'[39m +
                      [32m'* Health check endpoints\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'### Platform Limits\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'| Feature                  | Limit / Specification                                         |\n'[39m +
                      [32m'| :----------------------- | :------------------------------------------------------------ |\n'[39m +
                      [32m'| **Max File Size**        | 50 MB per document                                            |\n'[39m +
                      [32m'| **Max Batch Size**       | 100 documents per `add()` request                             |\n'[39m +
                      [32m'| **Supported File Types** | `.pdf`, `.txt`, `.docx`, `.md`, `.json`, `.csv`               |\n'[39m +
                      [32m'| **Token Limit**          | 8,192 tokens per document chunk                               |\n'[39m +
                      [32m'| **Metadata Fields**      | Max 20 keys per document; Values must be `string` or `number` |\n'[39m +
                      [32m'| **Indexing Speed**       | \\~120 records/sec (Text), \\~5 sec/page (OCR PDF)              |\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'## Still Stuck?\n'[39m +

                      [32m''[39m

            [32m'It also helps the user understand the progress of the task and overall progress of their requests.\n'[39m +
            [32m'\n'[39m +
            [32m'## When to Use This Tool\n'[39m +
            [32m'Use this tool proactively in these scenarios:\n'[39m +
            [32m'\n'[39m +
            [32m'1. Complex multi-step tasks - When a task requires 3 or more distinct steps or actions\n'[39m +

            [32m'## Task States and Management\n'[39m +

                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'Markdown Content:\n'[39m +
                      [32m'> ## Documentation Index\n'[39m +
                      [32m'> Fetch the complete documentation index at: https://getalchemystai.com/docs/llms.txt\n'[39m +
                      [32m'> Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'# Typescript SDK\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'> Get started with the Alchemyst Typescript SDK\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'### Installation\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m' ```bash Npm theme={null} npm install @alchemystai/sdk ``` ```bash Yarn theme={null} yarn add @alchemystai/sdk ``` ```bash Pnpm theme={null} pnpm add @alchemystai/sdk ``` ```bash Bun theme={null} bun add @alchemystai/sdk ``` \n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'### Authentication\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'Set your API key via environment variable or pass it directly when initializing the client.\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'* Recommended env var: `ALCHEMYST_AI_API_KEY`\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'```bash theme={null}\n'[39m +
                      [32m'export ALCHEMYST_AI_API_KEY="your_api_key_here"\n'[39m +
                      [32m'```\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'### Quickstart\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'```ts theme={null}\n'[39m +
                      [32m"import AlchemystAI from '@alchemystai/sdk';\n"[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'const client = new AlchemystAI({\n'[39m +
                      [32m'    apiKey: process.env.ALCHEMYST_AI_API_KEY,\n'[39m +
                      [32m'});\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'async function main() {\n'[39m +
                      [32m'  const res = await client.v1.context.view.retrieve();\n'[39m +
                      [32m'  console.log(res);\n'[39m +
                      [32m'}\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'main().catch(console.error);\n'[39m +
                      [32m'```\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'### Usage by Endpoint\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'All methods return a promise you can `await`. Types are available out-of-the-box in TypeScript.\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'#### Context: Add\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'```ts theme={null}\n'[39m +
                      [32m"import AlchemystAI from '@alchemystai/sdk';\n"[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'const client = new AlchemystAI({\n'[39m +
                      [32m'    apiKey: process.env.ALCHEMYST_AI_API_KEY,\n'[39m +
                      [32m'});\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'try {\n'[39m +
                      [32m'    await client.v1.context.add({\n'[39m +
                      [32m'       // [REQUIRED] The actual data to embed\n'[39m +
                      [32m'      documents: [\n'[39m +
                      [32m'                {\n'[39m +
                      [32m"                  content: 'The content of the document',\n"[39m +
                      [32m'                },\n'[39m +
                      [32m'              ],\n'[39m +
                      [32m'              // [REQUIRED] System classifications\n'[39m +
                      [32m"              context_type: 'resource',\n"[39m +
                      [32m"              source: 'web-upload',\n"[39m +
                      [32m"              scope: 'internal',\n"[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'              // [OPTIONAL] Can be null. Use for filtering later.\n'[39m +
                      [32m'              metadata: {\n'[39m +
                      [32m"                fileName: 'notes.txt',\n"[39m +
                      [32m"                fileType: 'text/plain',\n"[39m +
                      [32m'                lastModified: new Date().toISOString(),\n'[39m +
                      [32m'                fileSize: 1024,\n'[39m +
                      [32m"                groupName: ['group1', 'group2'],\n"[39m +
                      [32m'            },\n'[39m +
                      [32m'    });\n'[39m +
                      [32m'    console.log("Context successfully added.")\n'[39m +
                      [32m'    \n'[39m +
                      [32m'} catch (error) {\n'[39m +
                      [32m"    //Handles validation error (eg. missing required fields like 'documents')\n"[39m +
                      [32m'    console.error("Error adding context:", error)    \n'[39m +
                      [32m'}\n'[39m +
                      [32m'```\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m' **Version Requirements**: The `groupName` field is introduced in TypeScript SDK version 0.6.0. If you use `groupName` in previous versions, you will encounter an error. If `groupName` is not provided, it will be set to a default value REDACTEDmatically. \n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m" **groupName**: The group name acts like a namespace which creates a scope for context. Documents with the same group name will be grouped together for better organization and retrieval. **Example Use Cases**: * `['project-alpha']` - Group all documents related to a specific project * `['customer-support', 'tier-1']` - Organize support documentation by department and priority * `['legal', 'contracts']` - Categorize legal documents by type and category * `['training', 'onboarding']` - Group training materials for new employee onboarding \n"[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'#### Context: Search\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'```ts theme={null}\n'[39m +
                      [32m"import AlchemystAI from '@alchemystai/sdk';\n"[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'const client = new AlchemystAI({\n'[39m +
                      [32m'  apiKey: process.env.ALCHEMYST_AI_API_KEY,\n'[39m +
                      [32m'});\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'try {\n'[39m +
                      [32m'  const { contexts } = await client.v1.context.search({\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'    // [REQUIRED] Core search parameters\n'[39m +
                      [32m"    query: 'Your search query here',\n"[39m +
                      [32m'    similarity_threshold: 0.8,\n'[39m +
                      [32m'    minimum_similarity_threshold: 0.5,\n'[39m +
                      [32m"    scope: 'internal',\n"[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'    // Optional - can be null\n'[39m +
                      [32m'    body_metadata: {\n'[39m +
                      [32m"       groupName: ['project-alpha'],\n"[39m +
                      [32m"       fileType: 'ai/conversation',\n"[39m +
                      [32m'    },\n'[39m +
                      [32m'  });\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'  console.log(contexts);\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'} \n'[39m +
                      [32m'catch (error) {\n'[39m +
                      [32m'  console.error("Search failed:", error);\n'[39m +
                      [32m'}\n'[39m +
                      [32m'```\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'#### Context: Delete\n'[39m +

                      [32m'```ts theme={null}\n'[39m +

                      [32m'```typescript theme={null}\n'[39m +
                      [32m`const answer = await llm.generate("What's our refund policy?");\n`[39m +
                      [32m'// "We offer a 30-day money back guarantee. Contact support@example.com..." ✅\n'[39m +
                      [32m'```\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'***\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'## Prerequisites\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'* Alchemyst account ([sign up](https://platform.getalchemystai.com/auth?utm_source=docs\\&utm_campaign=contextual_ai_quickstart\\&utm_medium=quickstart_article\\&utm_content=prerequisites_signup_cta))\n'[39m +
                      [32m'* Your `ALCHEMYST_AI_API_KEY`\n'[39m +
                      [32m'* Node.js 18+ or Python 3.9+\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'**Time to complete:** 10 minutes\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'***\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'## Step 1: Install\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m' ```bash npm theme={null} npm install @alchemystai/sdk ``` ```bash python theme={null} pip install alchemystai ``` \n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'***\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'## Step 2: Initialize\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m' ```typescript TypeScript theme={null} import AlchemystAI from \'@alchemystai/sdk\'; const client = new AlchemystAI({ apiKey: process.env.ALCHEMYST_AI_API_KEY, }); ``` ```python Python theme={null} import os from alchemyst_ai import AlchemystAI client = AlchemystAI( api_key=os.environ.get("ALCHEMYST_AI_API_KEY") ) ``` \n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'***\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'## Step 3: Store a Document\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m' ```typescript TypeScript theme={null} const result = await client.v1.context.add({ documents: [{ content: "Our refund policy: We offer a 30-day money back guarantee. Contact support@example.com to request a refund." }], context_type: \'resource\', source: \'documentation\', scope: \'internal\' }); console.log(`✅ Stored ${result.documents?.length || 0} documents`); // Output: ✅ Stored 1 documents ``` ```python Python theme={null} result = client.v1.context.add( documents=[{ "content": "Our refund policy: We offer a 30-day money back guarantee. Contact support@example.com to request a refund." }], context_type="resource", source="documentation", scope="internal" ) print(f"✅ Stored {len(result.get(\'documents\', []))} documents") # Output: ✅ Stored 1 documents ``` \n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'**What just happened:**\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'* Your document was chunked into searchable pieces (\\~500 word chunks)\n'[39m +
                      [32m'* Embeddings were generated REDACTEDmatically (vector representations)\n'[39m +
                      [32m'* Everything is indexed and ready to search\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'**Verify it worked:**\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'1. Visit [platform.getalchemystai.com/context](https://platform.getalchemystai.com/context?utm_source=docs\\&utm_campaign=contextual_ai_quickstart\\&utm_medium=quickstart_article\\&utm_content=verify_setup_context_link)\n'[39m +
                      [32m'2. You should see your document listed\n'[39m +
                      [32m'3. Click to view chunks and metadata\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'***\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'## Step 4: Search for Context\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m' ```typescript TypeScript theme={null} const userQuestion = "What\'s your refund policy?"; const { contexts } = await client.v1.context.search({ query: userQuestion, similarity_threshold: 0.7, scope: \'internal\' }); console.log(`Found ${contexts?.length || 0} relevant chunks`); // Output: Found 1 relevant chunks console.log(contexts[0].content); // Output: "Our refund policy: We offer a 30-day money back guarantee..." ``` ```python Python theme={null} user_question = "What\'s your refund policy?" result = client.v1.context.search( query=user_question, similarity_threshold=0.7, scope="internal" ) contexts = result.contexts or [] print(f"Found {len(contexts)} relevant chunks") # Output: Found 1 relevant chunks print(contexts[0].content) # Output: "Our refund policy: We offer a 30-day money back guarantee..." ``` \n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'### Understanding similarity\\_threshold\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'| Value | Meaning           | When to Use                        |\n'[39m +
                      [32m'| ----- | ----------------- | ---------------------------------- |\n'[39m +
                      [32m'| `0.5` | Somewhat relevant | Exploratory searches, broad topics |\n'[39m +
                      [32m'| `0.7` | Relevant          | **Start here** - good balance      |\n'[39m +
                      [32m'| `0.9` | Very relevant     | Precise matches, technical queries |\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m' **Tip:** Start at 0.7, lower to 0.5 if you get no results, raise to 0.9 if results are too broad. \n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'***\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'## Step 5: Feed Context to Your LLM\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m' ```typescript TypeScript theme={null} import OpenAI from \'openai\'; const openai = new OpenAI(); const prompt = contexts?.length ? `Context:\\n${contexts.map(c => c.content).join(\'\\n\\n\')}\\n\\nQuestion: ${userQuestion}` : userQuestion; const response = await openai.chat.completions.create({ model: "gpt-4", messages: [{ role: "user", content: prompt }] }); console.log(response.choices[0].message.content); // Output: "We offer a 30-day money back guarantee. To request a refund, contact support@example.com." ``` ```python Python theme={null} import openai if contexts: context_text = "\\n\\n".join([ctx.content for ctx in contexts]) prompt = f"Context:\\n{context_text}\\n\\nQuestion: {user_question}" else: prompt = user_question response = openai.chat.completions.create( model="gpt-4", messages=[{"role": "user", "content": prompt}] ) print(response.choices[0].message.content) # Output: "We offer a 30-day money back guarantee. To request a refund, contact support@example.com." ``` \n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'**Result:** Your AI now answers from YOUR data, not generic training data.\n'[39m +

                      [32m'  ```typescript theme={null} import AlchemystAI from \'@alchemystai/sdk\'; import OpenAI from \'openai\'; const alchemyst = new AlchemystAI({ apiKey: process.env.ALCHEMYST_AI_API_KEY, }); const openai = new OpenAI(); async function main() { // 1. Generate answer with context const prompt = contexts?.length ? `Context:\\n${contexts.map(c => c.content).join(\'\\n\\n\')}\\n\\nQuestion: ${userQuestion}` : userQuestion; const response = await openai.chat.completions.create({ model: "gpt-4", messages: [{ role: "user", content: prompt }] }); console.log("AI Response:", response.choices[0].message.content); } main(); ``` **Expected Output:** ``` ✅ Document stored Found 1 relevant chunks AI Response: We offer a 30-day money back guarantee. To request a refund, contact support@example.com. ```   ```python theme={null} import os from alchemyst_ai import AlchemystAI import openai alchemyst = AlchemystAI(api_key=os.environ.get("ALCHEMYST_AI_API_KEY")) def main(): # 1. Store document alchemyst.v1.context.add( documents=[{ "content": "Our refund policy: We offer a 30-day money back guarantee. Search for context user_question = "What\'s your refund policy?" result = alchemyst.v1.context.search( query=user_question, similarity_threshold=0.7, scope="internal" ) contexts = result.contexts or [] print(f"Found {len(contexts)} relevant chunks") # 3. Generate answer with context if contexts: context_text = "\\n\\n".join([ctx.content for ctx in contexts]) prompt = f"Context:\\n{context_text}\\n\\nQuestion: {user_question}" else: prompt = user_question response = openai.chat.completions.create( model="gpt-4", messages=[{"role": "user", "content": prompt}] ) print("AI Response:", response.choices[0].message.content) if __name__ == "__main__": main() ``` **Expected Output:** ``` ✅ Document stored Found 1 relevant chunks AI Response: We offer a 30-day money back guarantee. To request a refund, contact support@example.com. ``` \n'[39m +

                      [32m'> ## Documentation Index\n'[39m +
                      [32m'> Fetch the complete documentation index at: https://getalchemystai.com/docs/llms.txt\n'[39m +
                      [32m'> Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'# Errors & Platform Limits\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'> Understanding common issues you might face, while building with Alchemyst\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'## Quick Diagnosis\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m"* Can't upload? [see Upload Errors](#common-errors-add)\n"[39m +
                      [32m'* Search not working? [go to Search Errors](#common-errors-search)\n'[39m +
                      [32m'* Slow performance? [look at Performance Issues](#performance-issues)\n'[39m +
                      [32m'* Wrong results? [Check Retrieval Quality](#retrieval-quality-issues)\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'## API Errors\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'### Common errors (Add)\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'| Status Code | Error Type        | Common Cause                                                                      | Recommended Fix                                                                                                                                       |\n'[39m +
                      [32m'| :---------- | :---------------- | :-------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | :---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |\n'[39m +
                      [32m'| **400**     | `BadRequest`      | Invalid JSON or missing required fields (e.g., `source`).                         | Validate your payload against the [schema](/api-reference/endpoint/api/v1/context/add/post). Ensure `documents` array is not empty.                   |\n'[39m +
                      [32m"| **401**     | `Unauthorized`    | Invalid or missing `ALCHEMYST_AI_API_KEY`.                                        | Check your `.env` file. Ensure you aren't using a Test key in Prod.                                                                                   |\n"[39m +
                      [32m"| **403**     | `Forbidden`       | Accessing a `scope` (e.g., `user_123`) you don't have permission for.             | Verify the `api_key` or `user_id` matches the authenticated session. Make sure the key is still valid.                                                |\n"[39m +
                      [32m'| **409**     | `Conflict`        | Document with the same `fileName` already exists.                                 | Follow [Pattern 2: Document Updates](/advanced/usage-patterns#pattern-2%3A-handling-document-updates) to update or replace existing documents safely. |\n'[39m +
                      [32m'| **413**     | `PayloadTooLarge` | Document exceeds the 50MB limit or batch size > 100.                              | Split your `documents` array into chunks of 50 and retry.                                                                                             |\n'[39m +
                      [32m'| **429**     | `RateLimit`       | Exceeded 1000 requests/minute.                                                    | Implement exponential backoff (default in SDK). Contact support for higher limits.                                                                    |\n'[39m +
                      [32m'| **422**     | `Unprocessable`   | The file type provided in `metadata` matches `source` but content is unparseable. | Ensure `fileType` matches the actual binary content (e.g., don’t send PDF bytes as `text/plain`).                                                     |\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'### Common errors (Search)\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'| Status Code | Error Type      | Common Cause                                  | Recommended Fix                                                                                                                             |\n'[39m +
                      [32m'| :---------- | :-------------- | :-------------------------------------------- | :------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |\n'[39m +
                      [32m'| **400**     | `BadRequest`    | Missing or malformed search parameters.       | Ensure `query` is provided and properly formatted.Validate your payload against the [schema](/api-reference/endpoint/api/v1/context/search) |\n'[39m +
                      [32m'| **401**     | `Unauthorized`  | Invalid or missing `ALCHEMYST_AI_API_KEY`.    | Confirm the request includes a valid API key.                                                                                               |\n'[39m +
                      [32m"| **403**     | `Forbidden`     | Searching a `scope` you don't have access to. | Make sure the key is still valid. Ensure the search `scope` is accessible to the current user or org.                                       |\n"[39m +
                      [32m'| **429**     | `RateLimit`     | Too many search requests.                     | Add throttling or cache repeated searches.                                                                                                  |\n'[39m +
                      [32m'| **422**     | `Unprocessable` | Documents were not indexed correctly.         | Verify documents were successfully ingested before searching.                                                                               |\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'## Application-Level Issues\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'### Performance issues\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'#### Slow Ingestion\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'**Diagnosis:**\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'```javascript theme={null}\n'[39m +
                      [32m'// Sequential adds: ~30 seconds for 1000 docs\n'[39m +
                      [32m'for (let i = 0; i < 1000; i++) {\n'[39m +
                      [32m'  await alchemyst.add(documents[i]);\n'[39m +
                      [32m'}\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'// Async add: ~3 seconds for 1000 docs (10x faster!)\n'[39m +
                      [32m'// documents is an array of content\n'[39m +
                      [32m'const documents = [];\n'[39m +
                      [32m'documents.push({\n'[39m +
                      [32m'  content: "files content",\n'[39m +
                      [32m'  metadata: { // optional\n'[39m +
                      [32m'    file_name: "file_name",\n'[39m +
                      [32m'    file_type: "pdf/txt/json",\n'[39m +
                      [32m'    group_name: ["group1", "group2"],\n'[39m +
                      [32m'  },\n'[39m +
                      [32m'});\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'await alchemyst.add(documents);\n'[39m +
                      [32m'```\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'**Common Causes:**\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'* Document size > 50MB (max file size - 50MB)\n'[39m +
                      [32m'* Large number of documents uploaded sequentially\n'[39m +
                      [32m'* Token limit reached\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'**Solutions :**\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'1. Make sure the doc size is less then 50MB\n'[39m +
                      [32m'2. Upload documents via bulkAdd (faster)\n'[39m +
                      [32m'3. Check if you have sufficent tokens\n'[39m +
                      [32m'4. For bulk operations read [here](/advanced/usage-patterns#pattern-4%3A-bulk-operations-at-scale)\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'***\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'#### Slow Searches (> 1 second)\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'**Quick Checks:**\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'```javascript theme={null}\n'[39m +
                      [32m'// Measure your query time\n'[39m +
                      [32m'const start = Date.now();\n'[39m +
                      [32m'const result = await alchemyst.v1.context.search({\n'[39m +
                      [32m'  groupName: ["a", "b", "c", "d", "e", "f", "g"] // 7 filters!\n'[39m +
                      [32m'});\n'[39m +
                      [32m'console.log(`Search took ${Date.now() - start}ms`);\n'[39m +
                      [32m'```\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'**Common Causes:**\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'* 7+ groupName tags (exponential overhead)\n'[39m +
                      [32m'* No minimum\\_similarity\\_threshold set\n'[39m +
                      [32m'* 10K+ documents in scope\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'**Solutions:**\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'1. Reduce to 3-5 groupName tags max\n'[39m +
                      [32m'2. Set minimum\\_similarity\\_threshold: 0.5\n'[39m +
                      [32m'3. Use namespaces to shard data\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'***\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'### Retrieval Quality Issues\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'#### No Results Returned\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'**Quick Checks:**\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'```javascript theme={null}\n'[39m +
                      [32m'// 1. Verify documents exist\n'[39m +
                      [32m'const docs = await alchemyst.v1.context.view();\n'[39m +
                      [32m'console.log(`Total docs: ${docs.length}`);\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'// 2. Try broader search\n'[39m +
                      [32m'const result = await alchemyst.v1.context.search({\n'[39m +
                      [32m'  query: "your query",\n'[39m +
                      [32m'  similarity_threshold: 0.5, // Lower threshold\n'[39m +
                      [32m'  groupName: ["broad_tag"] // Fewer filters\n'[39m +
                      [32m'});\n'[39m +
                      [32m'```\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'**Common Causes:**\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'* High minimum\\_similarity\\_threshold set\n'[39m +
                      [32m"* groupnames don't intersect\n"[39m +
                      [32m'* Query is not relevant or very specific\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'**Solutions :**\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'1. Verify documents exist : [platform](https://platform.getalchemystai.com/context)\n'[39m +
                      [32m'2. Reduce similarity\\_threshold from 0.6-0.7 to 0.5-0.6\n'[39m +
                      [32m'3. Remove overly specific groupNames\n'[39m +
                      [32m"4. Try with a general query, make sure it's not too specific\n"[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'***\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'### Common Scenarios\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'#### Scenario: Queries Return Too Many Fragments\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'* **Problem:** Search returns 50+ small chunks\n'[39m +
                      [32m'* **Cause:** Over-segmentation (see [Anti-Pattern 1](/advanced/usage-patterns#anti-pattern-1%3A-over-segmentation))\n'[39m +
                      [32m'* **Solution:** Combine related content into cohesive documents\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'#### Scenario : Metadata Bloat Symptoms\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +

                      [32m'* **Solution:** Limit metadata to only what you query/filter by, pass all the other things in the content itself.\n'[39m +

                    text: [32m'# FAQ - by Mindie Kniss - Alchemist - Substack\n'[39m +
                      [32m'created: 2025-06-25, last updated: 2025-09-19, [Read more](https://wayofthealchemist.substack.com/p/faq)\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'While there is no free trial period for Alchemist, you can sign up for the monthly plan for just $44 today, then cancel at any time.\n'[39m +
                      [32m"Of course, if you're planning to be a part of Alchemist for a while, the yearly plan of $444 gives you two months free.\n"[39m +
                      [32m'...\n'[39m +
                      [32m'You can cancel your subscription at any time by logging into your Substack.com account and then navigating to your Subscriptions by clicking on your account icon (top right on the web).\n'[39m +
                      [32m'You will continue to receive full access to Alchemist until the end of your current billing cycle.\n'[39m +
                      [32m'...\n'[39m +
                      [32m'All payments are made at the start of your billing cycle, whether you are paying monthly or yearly.\n'[39m +
                      [32m'At this time, Alchemist does not offer any refunds (prorated or in full) when canceling your subscription.\n'[39m +
                      [32m'Please note that even if you do cancel your subscription, you will continue to have full access to Alchemist for the remainder of your current billing period.'[39m
                  },
                  {
                    type: [32m'text'[39m,
                    text: [32m'# How does Alchemy bill me for my usage?\n'[39m +
                      [32m'created: undefined, last updated: 2026-03-29, [Read more](https://www.alchemy.com/support/how-does-alchemy-bill-me-for-my-usage)\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'With Pay-as-you-go, you’re billed based on the usage your team generates.\n'[39m +
                      [32m'Usage accrues continuously as you make requests.\n'[39m +
                      [32m'You’re only charged for what you use, not a fixed monthly fee.\n'[39m +
                      [32m'...\n'[39m +
                      [32m'Instead of charging on a fixed schedule, Pay-as-you-go uses **billing thresholds**.\n'[39m +
                      [32m'- Each account has a threshold that represents how much usage can accrue before a charge is attempted.\n'[39m +
                      [32m'- When your balance reaches the threshold, we attempt to collect payment REDACTEDmatically.\n'[39m +
                      [32m'- Thresholds can increase over time as invoices are successfully paid.\n'[39m +
                      [32m'- Threshold growth is gradual and based on payment history, not sudden usage spikes.\n'[39m +
                      [32m'...\n'[39m +
                      [32m'That charge includes all usage since the last successful payment.\n'[39m +
                      [32m'...\n'[39m +
                      [32m'There is no fixed billing day for Pay-as-you-go accounts.\n'[39m +
                      [32m'- Charges happen when your threshold is reached, or\n'[39m +
                      [32m'- At the end of a billing period if there is an outstanding balance (typically the 1st of each month)\n'[39m +
                      [32m'Each charge includes:\n'[39m +
                      [32m'- Newly accrued usage\n'[39m +
                      [32m'- Any unpaid balance from before\n'[39m +
                      [32m'...\n'[39m +
                      [32m'If a charge or invoice is not paid:\n'[39m +
                      [32m'- We retry payment attempts over a short time window.\n'[39m +
                      [32m'- Continued non-payment will lead to temporary limits on usage.\n'[39m +
                      [32m'- Usage is restored once the outstanding balance is settled.'[39m
                  },

          type: [32m'function'[39m,
          name: [32m'executeCommand'[39m,
          description: [32m'Executes a given bash command in a persistent shell session with optional timeout, ensuring proper handling and security measures.\n'[39m +
            [32m'\n'[39m +
            [32m'IMPORTANT: This tool is for terminal operations like git, npm, docker, etc. DO NOT use it for file operations (reading, writing, editing, searching, finding files) - use the specialized tools for this instead.\n'[39m +
            [32m'\n'[39m +
            [32m'Before executing the command, please follow these steps:\n'[39m +
            [32m'\n'[39m +
            [32m'1. Directory Verification:\n'[39m +
            [32m'   - If the command will create new directories or files, first use listFiles to verify the parent directory exists and is the correct location\n'[39m +
            [32m'   - For example, before running "mkdir foo/bar", first use listFiles to check that "foo" exists and is the intended parent directory\n'[39m +
            [32m'\n'[39m +
            [32m'2. Command Execution:\n'[39m +
            [32m'   - Always quote file paths that contain spaces with double quotes (e.g., cd "path with spaces/file.txt")\n'[39m +
            [32m'   - Examples of proper quoting:\n'[39m +
            [32m'     - cd "/Users/name/My Documents" (correct)\n'[39m +
            [32m'     - cd /Users/name/My Documents (incorrect - will fail)\n'[39m +
            [32m'     - python "/path/with spaces/script.py" (correct)\n'[39m +
            [32m'     - python /path/with spaces/script.py (incorrect - will fail)\n'[39m +
            [32m'   - After ensuring proper quoting, execute the command.\n'[39m +
            [32m'   - Capture the output of the command.\n'[39m +
            [32m'\n'[39m +
            [32m'Usage notes:\n'[39m +
            [32m'- The command argument is required.\n'[39m +
            [32m'- You can specify an optional timeout in seconds (up to 300s / 5 minutes). If not specified, commands will timeout after 60s (1 minute).\n'[39m +
            [32m'- If the output exceeds 30000 characters, output will be truncated before being returned to you.\n'[39m +
            [32m'- When issuing multiple commands:\n'[39m +
            [32m'  - If the commands are independent and can run in parallel, make multiple executeCommand tool calls in a single message. For example, if you need to run "git status" and "git diff", send a single message with two executeCommand tool calls in parallel.\n'[39m +
            [32m'  - If the commands depend on each other and must run sequentially, use a single executeCommand call with \'&&\' to chain them together (e.g., `git add . && git commit -m "message" && git push`). For instance, if one operation must complete before another starts (like mkdir before cp, Write before executeCommand for git operations, or git add before git commit), run these operations sequentially instead.\n'[39m +
            [32m"  - Use ';' only when you need to run commands sequentially but don't care if earlier commands fail\n"[39m +
            [32m'  - DO NOT use newlines to separate commands (newlines are ok in quoted strings)\n'[39m +
            [32m"- You shall avoid use the markdown code block syntax (backtick, '`') in your command, as it will be interpreted as a command substitution.\n"[39m +

You must also consider if the command you need to run should be executed in a specific directory rather than the current working directory, and properly set the `cwd` if necessary.\n"[39m +
            [32m'\n'[39m +
            [32m'# Committing changes with git\n'[39m +
            [32m'\n'[39m +
            [32m'Only create commits when requested by the user. If unclear, ask first. When the user asks you to create a new git commit, follow these steps carefully:\n'[39m +
            [32m'\n'[39m +
            [32m'Git Safety Protocol:\n'[39m +
            [32m'- NEVER update the git config\n'[39m +
            [32m"- NEVER run destructive git commands (push --force, reset --hard, checkout ., restore ., clean -f, branch -D) unless the user explicitly requests these actions. Taking unauthorized destructive actions is unhelpful and can result in lost work, so it's best to ONLY run these commands when given direct instructions \n"[39m +
            [32m'- NEVER skip hooks (--no-verify, --no-gpg-sign, etc) unless the user explicitly requests it\n'[39m +
            [32m'- NEVER run force push to main/master, warn the user if they request it\n'[39m +
            [32m'- CRITICAL: Always create NEW commits rather than amending, unless the user explicitly requests a git amend. When a pre-commit hook fails, the commit did NOT happen  — so --amend would modify the PREVIOUS commit, which may result in destroying work or losing previous changes. Instead, after hook failure, fix the issue, re-stage, and create a NEW commit\n'[39m +
            [32m'- When staging files, prefer adding specific files by name rather than using "git add -A" or "git add .", which can accidentally include sensitive files (.env, credentials) or large binaries\n'[39m +
            [32m'- NEVER commit changes unless the user explicitly asks you to. It is VERY IMPORTANT to only commit when explicitly asked, otherwise the user will feel that you are being too proactive\n'[39m +
            [32m'\n'[39m +
            [32m'1. You can call multiple tools in a single response. When multiple independent pieces of information are requested and all commands are likely to succeed, run multiple tool calls in parallel for optimal performance. run the following bash commands in parallel, each using the executeCommand tool:\n'[39m +
            [32m'  - Run a git status command to see all untracked files. IMPORTANT: Never use the -uall flag as it can cause memory issues on large repos.\n'[39m +
            [32m'  - Run a git diff command to see both staged and unstaged changes that will be committed.\n'[39m +
            [32m"  - Run a git log command to see recent commit messages, so that you can follow this repository's commit message style.\n"[39m +
            [32m'2. Analyze all staged changes (both previously staged and newly added) and draft a commit message:\n'[39m +
            [32m'  - Summarize the nature of the changes (eg. new feature, enhancement to an existing feature, bug fix, refactoring, test, docs, etc.). Ensure the message accurately reflects the changes and their purpose (i.e. "add" means a wholly new feature, "update" means an enhancement to an existing feature, "fix" means a bug fix, etc.).\n'[39m +
            [32m'  - Do not commit files that likely contain secrets (.env, credentials.json, etc). Warn the user if they specifically request to commit those files\n'[39m +
            [32m'  - Draft a concise (1-2 sentences) commit message that focuses on the "why" rather than the "what"\n'[39m +
            [32m'  - Ensure it accurately reflects the changes and their purpose\n'[39m +
            [32m'3. You can call multiple tools in a single response. When multiple independent pieces of information are requested and all commands are likely to succeed, run multiple tool calls in parallel for optimal performance. run the following commands:\n'[39m +
            [32m'   - Add relevant untracked files to the staging area.\n'[39m +
            [32m'   - Create the commit with a message ending with:\n'[39m +
            [32m'   🤖 Generated with [Pochi](https://getpochi.com) | [Task](<Share URL>)\n'[39m +
            [32m'\n'[39m +
            [32m'   Co-Authored-By: Pochi <noreply@getpochi.com>\n'[39m +
            [32m'\n'[39m +
            [32m'   Note: Replace <Share URL> with the Share URL from system information if available. If not available, omit the " | [Task](...)" part.\n'[39m +
            [32m'\n'[39m +
            [32m'   - Run git status after the commit completes to verify success.\n'[39m +
            [32m'   Note: git status depends on the commit completing, so run it sequentially after the commit.\n'[39m +
            [32m'4. If the commit fails due to pre-commit hook changes, retry the commit ONCE to include these REDACTEDmated changes. If it fails again, it usually means a pre-commit hook is preventing the commit. If the commit succeeds but you notice that files were modified by the pre-commit hook, you MUST amend your commit to include them.\n'[39m +
            [32m'\n'[39m +
            [32m'Important notes:\n'[39m +
            [32m'- NEVER update the git config\n'[39m +
            [32m'- NEVER run additional commands to read or explore code, besides git bash commands\n'[39m +
            [32m'- DO NOT push to the remote repository unless the user explicitly asks you to do so\n'[39m +
            [32m'- IMPORTANT: Never use git commands with the -i flag (like git rebase -i or git add -i) since they require interactive input which is not supported.\n'[39m +
            [32m'- IMPORTANT: Do not use --no-edit with git rebase commands, as the --no-edit flag is not a valid option for git rebase.\n'[39m +
            [32m'- If there are no changes to commit (i.e., no untracked files and no modifications), do not create an empty commit\n'[39m +
            [32m'- In order to ensure good formatting, ALWAYS pass the commit message via a HEREDOC, a la this example:\n'[39m +
            [32m'<example>\n'[39m +
            [32m`git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'\n`[39m +
            [32m'Commit message here.\n'[39m +
            [32m'\n'[39m +
            [32m'🤖 Generated with [Pochi](https://getpochi.com) | [Task](<Share URL>)\n'[39m +
            [32m'\n'[39m +
            [32m'Co-Authored-By: Pochi <noreply@getpochi.com>\n'[39m +
            [32m'EOF\n'[39m +
            [32m')"\n'[39m +
            [32m'</example>\n'[39m +
            [32m'\n'[39m +
            [32m'# Creating pull requests\n'[39m +
            [32m'Use the gh command via the executeCommand tool for ALL GitHub-related tasks including working with issues, pull requests, checks, and releases. If given a Github URL use the gh command to get the information needed.\n'[39m +
            [32m'\n'[39m +
            [32m'IMPORTANT: When the user asks you to create a pull request, follow these steps carefully:\n'[39m +
            [32m'\n'[39m +
            [32m'1. You can call multiple tools in a single response. When multiple independent pieces of information are requested and all commands are likely to succeed, run multiple tool calls in parallel for optimal performance. run the following bash commands in parallel using the executeCommand tool, in order to understand the current state of the branch since it diverged from the main branch:\n'[39m +
            [32m'   - Run a git status command to see all untracked files (never use -uall flag)\n'[39m +
            [32m'   - Run a git diff command to see both staged and unstaged changes that will be committed\n'[39m +
            [32m'   - Check if the current branch tracks a remote branch and is up to date with the remote, so you know if you need to push to the remote\n'[39m +
            [32m'   - Run a git log command and `git diff [base-branch]...HEAD` to understand the full commit history for the current branch (from the time it diverged from the base branch)\n'[39m +
            [32m'2. Analyze all changes that will be included in the pull request, making sure to look at all relevant commits (NOT just the latest commit, but ALL commits that will be included in the pull request!!!), and draft a pull request title and summary:\n'[39m +
            [32m'   - Keep the PR title short (under 70 characters)\n'[39m +
            [32m'   - Use the description/body for details, not the title\n'[39m +
            [32m'3. You can call multiple tools in a single response. When multiple independent pieces of information are requested and all commands are likely to succeed, run multiple tool calls in parallel for optimal performance. run the following commands in parallel:\n'[39m +
            [32m'   - Create new branch if needed\n'[39m +
            [32m'   - Push to remote with -u flag if needed\n'[39m +
            [32m'   - Create PR using gh pr create with the format below. Use a HEREDOC to pass the body to ensure correct formatting.\n'[39m +

          description: [32m'Use this tool to create and manage a structured task list for your current coding session. This helps you track progress, organize complex tasks, and demonstrate thoroughness to the user.\n'[39m +
            [32m'It also helps the user understand the progress of the task and overall progress of their requests.\n'[39m +
            [32m'\n'[39m +
            [32m'## When to Use This Tool\n'[39m +
            [32m'Use this tool proactively in these scenarios:\n'[39m +
            [32m'\n'[39m +
            [32m'1. Complex multi-step tasks - When a task requires 3 or more distinct steps or actions\n'[39m +

            [32m'3. User explicitly requests todo list - When the user directly asks you to use the todo list\n'[39m +
            [32m'4. User provides multiple tasks - When users provide a list of things to be done (numbered or comma-separated)\n'[39m +
            [32m'5. After receiving new instructions - Immediately capture user requirements as todos. Feel free to edit the todo list based on new information.\n'[39m +
            [32m'6. After completing a task - Mark it complete and add any new follow-up tasks\n'[39m +
            [32m'7. When you start working on a new task, mark the todo as in-progress. Ideally you should only have one todo as in-progress at a time. Complete existing tasks before starting new ones.\n'[39m +
            [32m'\n'[39m +
            [32m'## When NOT to Use This Tool\n'[39m +
            [32m'\n'[39m +
            [32m'Skip using this tool when:\n'[39m +

            [32m'4. The task is purely conversational or informational\n'[39m +
            [32m'\n'[39m +

            [32m'\n'[39m +

            [32m'## Task States and Management\n'[39m +
